answer.explanation: Commit cf8a2c2 (17:17:56Z) changed the Thumbnailer's OUTPUT_BUCKET in template.yaml from !Ref OutputBucket to the nonexistent literal 'missing-bucket-lambda-rca'. The live configuration was updated at 17:20:25Z to match, so the deployed value is the bad one. From 17:20:37Z onward, the function logged 361 NoSuchBucket errors on PutObject, so every thumbnail invocation in the window fails. The earlier revert/re-apply pattern (97ce303, 228e964) shows this is a recurring bad template edit. The IAM policy and code are not at fault: the role allows s3:PutObject on the real OutputBucket, and the handler reads the env var as written.
